FIFA President Infantino Faces Ethics Complaint to IOC

FIFA President Gianni Infantino is facing an ethics complaint filed with the International Olympic Committee (IOC). The complaint reportedly stems from alleged breaches of political neutrality rules, specifically concerning alleged lobbying by former US President Donald Trump regarding a ban on player Folarin Balogun. The IOC has jurisdiction over Infantino as he is a member of its invited group.
